meta.rule_version: PhilHealth Circular 2020-0005 (Rev. 1) under RA 11223; PhilHealth Advisory 2026-0042 (5% for CY 2026)

employed.label: Employed
employed.note: Premium is shared equally: 50% employee, 50% employer, deducted through payroll.

self-earning.label: Self-Earning / Self-Paying
self-earning.note: Direct contributors pay the full premium themselves. Payment may be made monthly, quarterly, semi-annually, or annually.

ofw.label: OFW
ofw.note: Overseas Filipino workers are direct contributors and pay the full premium based on monthly income.

kasambahay.label: Kasambahay
kasambahay.note: If the kasambahay earns less than ₱5,000 per month, the household employer shoulders the entire premium.
